name: team_planning_scenario_costs
description: Get what each scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in costs over its own period, beside the baseline priced over the same days, with the difference: the same totals as team_planning_cost, for every scenario at once. Today comes first, under the plan's id, with basis run_rate: every seat priced for the year from the base date, totals carrying only `scenario`, never compared with a period total. Each scenario has basis period. Each total carries `parts`: actual, planned and forecast, as team_planning_cost defines them, adding up to it; actual there means the baseline's figure, not actual pay. Totals are per currency in `native`, and `converted` is the same in the reference currency at each period's start, null with `missing` saying why. `unpriced` counts the seats that can't be priced and so are left out, never counted as zero; team_planning_cost names them. A scenario that can't be priced has `error` instead of figures. Figures are decimal strings. An archived plan carries archived_on, frozen_on and a note: its figures use the pay bands, exchange rates, budget lines and rules as they stood on frozen_on, its archive day, while framework roles and levels are read as they are now. A plan archived before that copy was kept has no frozen_on, and its figures use today's. Restoring a plan prices it with today's again. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
